newsitem.title: USA: Venture Stores launches credit card.
newsitem.headline: Venture Stores launches credit card.

text.p: Venture Stores Inc, which operates 111 family discount stores in nine states, said on Friday that it is offering a private label credit card with no annual fee.

The card also offers a two percent rebate based on customer purchases made with the Venture credit card and a 10 percent discount on customers' first Venture Credit card purchase. In addition, special financing options, such as 90 days same as cash and 90 days interest-free will be offered by Venture during selected promotional periods, the retailer said in a statement.

"The Venture credit card supports one of the key elements of our repositioning strategy, which is to make shopping easier and more convenient for our customers," said Robert Wildrick, chairman and chief executive officer, in a statement.
"The credit card is one more step to help build store traffic and long-term customer loyalty," Wildrick said.
Financing is being provided by Beneficial National Bank USA, which is handling credit checks and credit card processing for Venture, it said.
